description: MainActivity class for an Android app that manages notification listener permissions, UI updates, and performs SSH tests using configured SSH clients.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity handling notification permissions, UI updates, and executing SSH commands.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI event handlers, and binds data flows.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes UI to reflect any permission changes when activity resumes.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine scope on activity destruction.

methods.name: bindUi
methods.description: Combines data flows to update UI elements for last results and SSH configuration.

methods.name: refreshPermissionUi
methods.description: Updates notification permission status UI and permission request buttons.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener permission is enabled.

methods.name: needsPostNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Determines if post-notification permission is needed on Android Tiramisu+.

methods.name: requestPostNotificationsIfNeededLegacy
methods.description: Requests post-notification permission if needed, for Android Tiramisu+.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results and refreshes UI accordingly.

methods.name: openSettingsActivity
methods.description: Navigates to settings activity or app details on error.

methods.name: openAppSelectionActivity
methods.description: Navigates to app selection activity or falls back to app details.

methods.name: launchTestSsh
methods.description: Performs SSH command execution (real or fake) and updates UI with result.
